annotations.title: Add a file to an agent knowledge base

description:
Add a file to an agent knowledge base

Adds a file as knowledge source to a voice agent, as the dashboard upload does. Send the file as base64 in `base64` with its name in `fileName`. Allowed are PDF, TXT, MD, CSV and JSON files of at most 15 MB; the content must match the extension (a PDF starts with `%PDF-`, text files are UTF-8), otherwise the request is rejected with 400. Over MCP the whole request may be at most 1 MB, so larger files go through the API directly. The document is created in the voice engine and attached to the agent. When that fails, the request still succeeds and the entry is stored with status `failed`; delete it and add it again.

agentId.description: Identifier of the voice agent. Accepted either as the public form `agent_12` or as the bare number `12`; the prefix is stripped before the lookup.

base64.description: The file content, base64 encoded. At most 15 MB decoded. Over MCP the whole request may be at most 1 MB, so larger files go through the API directly.

title.description: Human-readable title. Defaults to the file name.
